notes.title: Back to work!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]We wanted to give you a quick update on [i]Tarot[/i] and share what’s been happening behind the scenes. Recently, we’ve been navigating some unexpected family health issues, but we’re happy to share that everyone is safe and steadily recovering.[/p][p]Despite the delays, progress has continued on [i]Tarot[/i]. We’ve now completed 3 of the 4 major maps planned for the final release. Below, you’ll see a preview of the new starting area: [b]The City of Cups[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524585/8f39fe6f17bbc19968b4163e95e7b6397b318785.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your incredible patience and support during this time. It truly means a lot to us that so many of you have taken a chance on our studio’s first game. We’re excited for what’s ahead and can’t wait to share more with you soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned,
—Knights of Terminus[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 04/18/2025 Update
notes.notes:
Molly the intern cat had at work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524585/e1273a7f07a2fdd8e7afd591579560b355f8df06.jpg[/img]

Greetings, everyone,

We’d like to sincerely thank all of you who have supported Tarot since its launch on March 28th. As our studio’s debut title, it has been both exciting and rewarding to see players engaging with the game and sharing their experiences. Your early feedback and enthusiasm have been invaluable.
Today, we’re releasing a small update focused on improving the early-game experience and enhancing visual clarity:

Update Notes:

[list]
[*] All starting decks now include one healing card to provide greater balance during early encounters.

[*] A fire effect has been added to the selectable map component to improve visual feedback during navigation.
[/list]


Looking ahead, we will be publishing a brief Google Form survey at the end of the month to gather structured player feedback. Your insights will play a key role in guiding future development and refinement of Tarot.

Thank you once again for your continued support.
— Knights of Terminus
